description_en: Deletes the association between an Express Connect Router (ECR) and a route policy
description_zh: 删除专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）与路由策略的关联关系
name: DeleteRouteMapAssociation

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether it is only a dry run for this request. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without modifying the EPS resource.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route policy association
parameters.name: association_id
